row:
Farm Animal Rescue is a not for profit refuge for animals that have been freed from abusive situations and factory farms.  Once at sanctuary they live blissfully, free roaming in their forever home, receiving the best care to live out their natural lives in safety and harmony.  As well as rescue farmed animals, our mission is to speak up for animals farmed in the agriculture and food industry, exposing institutional cruelty and enabling people to emotionally connect with animals normally consumed for food.  

The farm is open to visitors on a regular basis, so that people can come to meet our residents. Each visitor has the opportunity to rub a pigs belly, pat a sheep, tumble around with a goat, and feed a rooster. During these animal contact sessions, we will tell visitors what the animals endured before they were rescued, and what life is really like for the millions of others on factory farms that we cannot save.
